description: This file defines the ServiceRegistry class, which manages known service instances within a Java application, including registration and lookup of services by port, and generates a unique process identifier for the JVM instance.

classes.name: ServiceRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration and lookup of service handles within a JVM, including generating a unique process ID.

methods.name: registerService(SameProcessServiceHandle service)
methods.description: Registers a service handle by its IPC and event ports.

methods.name: getServiceForIpcPort(int port)
methods.description: Retrieves the service handle associated with a given IPC port.

methods.name: getServiceForEventPort(int port)
methods.description: Retrieves the service handle associated with a given event port.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the lookup map and generates a unique process ID if not already set.

methods.name: getProcessIdentifier()
methods.description: Returns the unique process ID for this JVM instance.
